output.summary: A fast-growing shrub or small tree endemic to Argentina and Bolivia, it has heart-shaped leaves with a distinctive pungent smell. Its berries turn yellow-orange when ripe; ripe fruit is edible but may taste unpredictable or unpleasant, while unripe berries are mildly toxic.
output.edibilityNote: Ripe fruits are edible; unripe berries are mildly toxic, and flavor can be unpredictable or unpleasant.
